steps.label: 720p
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 26 -c:a aac -b:a 160k bk_720.mp4 && ls -l bk_720.mp4 > bk_prev.txt

steps.label: lautheit
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -hide_banner -i bk_film.mp4 -af ebur128 -f null - 2>&1 | tail -12 > bk_loud.txt; cat bk_loud.txt
